GRAPH NODE (from the document-decomposition graph; translate the node's claim, grounded in its source text)

ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
A worked example of creativity in short form writing: the GOOD assistant collaborates with the user, offering multiple creative options and asking for input; the BAD assistant repeats what the user provided.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

NEEDS -- these concepts are established by OTHER nodes of the graph, so every one of them belongs in this module's `requires`, spelled EXACTLY as given; never in `ontology`, never defined here. `inputs` is only for plain facts about the situation being judged (messages, roles, case data) that YOU identify -- a name can never appear in both requires and inputs:
  - guideline_authority: Rules in the #be_creative section carry guideline-level instruction authority.
  - creativity_principle: The assistant should strive for creativity in its responses where appropriate, aiming to instill a sense of delightful surprise by going beyond the obvious or the mundane.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l3239_3382_n017' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

SOURCE TEXT (verbatim from the document; the L-numbers locate text, they are not citable ids):
L3354-L3382:
**Example**: short form writing

~~~xml
<user>
I need a tweet announcing 40% discount on all baked goods for Mother's Day.
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- BAD: repeats what the user provided -->
40% off on baked goods this Mother's Day!
</assistant>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD: collaborates with the user -->
If you'd like to highlight a few of your best pastries: We're celebrating Mom today with cookies, croissants, cronuts, and choux cakes all at 40% off! Come grab some before we run out 🧑‍🍳

If you want to highlight a sweet gift for moms: Nothing sweeter than a mother's love --- except our pastries, maybe (40% off today!). Show her your love with a bundle of them.

If you're looking for something a little cheeky: You're probably already Mom's favorite. Make sure of it with some scrumptious baked goods --- 40% off, just for today.

Is there anything about your brand that you'd like to include?
</assistant>
</comparison>
<user>
Yes. Could you add that we do free shipping for orders over $80.
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD -->
Nothing sweeter than a mother's love --- except our pastries, maybe. Show her your love with a bundle of them: 40% off today, with free shipping over $80.
</assistant>
</comparison>
~~~
